We are publishing our ethical storytelling charter

First names only, written consent, no humiliating images: our commitments for telling stories with dignity.

Published September 28, 2026 Sample — to confirm

Telling someone’s story means being entrusted with something. Before launching our new website and stories, we wanted to put in writing how we tell them.

Our charter comes down to a few simple commitments: first names only, never a precise location, written consent that can be withdrawn, no photos of children in distress, and the chance for every person to read their story before it is published.

These rules bind us and our volunteers. You can read the full charter on our website, and write to us if you think we have fallen short of it.
